app_tagline: E-books to audiobooks with neural voices · EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, TXT → M4B, MP3
cli_description: Convert e-books into audiobooks in the terminal.
cli_files_help: e-books to convert (EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, TXT)
cli_output_help: folder where the audiobooks are saved
cli_lang_help: interface language ({langs}); default: the system language
opening_file_picker: Opening the file picker... (it may open behind this window)
no_file_chosen: No file chosen in the picker.
type_or_drag: Type or drag the files here (one or more per line). An empty line finishes.
opening_folder_picker: Opening the folder picker... (it may open behind this window)
no_folder_chosen: No folder chosen: using the default folder.
ffmpeg_linux_hint: (or dnf / pacman, depending on your distribution)
sample_failed: Could not generate the sample ({error}). Check your internet connection.
year_invalid: Use 4 digits, like 2024 (or leave it blank).
language_invalid: Language not recognized. Type the name (e.g. French, Greek) or the code (e.g. fr, el).
language_unknown_choose: The book's language was not recognized. Choose the narration language:
no_voices: There are no voices for {language}. Choose another narration language.
listen_usage: Use o + the voice number, for example: o {n}
reusing_choices: Using the same choices as the other books in {language}: {translation}, {sync}, voice {voice}
ask_sync: Create synced text for audiobook players?
reuse_choices_q: Use these choices for the other {n} book(s) in {language} too?
fmt_m4b_desc: one file with chapters and cover — the standard for audiobook apps
fmt_mp3_desc: one file with chapters and cover, plays on any device
fmt_multi_desc: one track per chapter, in a folder
fmt_opus_desc: the smallest file for the same quality
fmt_wav_desc: uncompressed, for editing (no chapters or cover)
ctrl_c_hint: Ctrl+C to cancel. If it stops midway, convert again: everything already narrated is reused.
cancel_q: Cancel the conversion? Everything already narrated is kept so you can resume later.
ended_early: The conversion process ended before finishing this book.
unsupported_format: Unsupported format: {name} (use EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3 or TXT)
none_readable: None of the files could be read.
err_unreadable: Could not read the text of this file (it may be protected or contain only images).
err_write: Could not write to the output folder ({0}). Check that it exists (an external drive may have been disconnected) or choose another one.
err_space: Not enough space in the output folder: about {0} GB is needed and {1} GB is free.
err_busy: This book is already being converted in another window. Wait for that conversion to finish (or cancel it) before converting again.
ffmpeg_missing_mp3: FFmpeg not found: only MP3 is available (without chapter volume levelling).
ffmpeg_install_for_more: Install it for M4B, Opus, FLAC and WAV:  {command}
cli_voice_help: voice to use (e.g. en-US-AndrewNeural); skips the voice question
cli_format_help: output format; skips the format question
cli_quality_help: audio quality: voice (default, the size of the source voice), standard, high or max
cli_translate_help: translate the books to this language
cli_sync_help: create synced text for audiobook players
cli_yes_help: no questions: use the options given and the last choices (or the defaults)
cli_lite_help: lite mode: one book at a time, leaves the computer free
cli_turbo_help: turbo mode: more connections and CPU, converts faster
voice_unknown: Unknown voice: {voice}. See the voice list without --voice.
err_translation_limit: Google's translation service refused the requests for excessive use. Wait a few minutes and convert again (what was already translated is kept), or convert without translating.
err_translation: Translation failed ({0}). Check your internet connection and convert again, or convert without translating.
err_tts: The voice service did not respond after several attempts ({0}). Check your internet connection and convert again: everything already narrated is kept and the conversion resumes where it stopped.
err_epub_corrupt: This EPUB is corrupted or incomplete (not a valid ZIP file).
err_epub_drm: This EPUB has DRM protection and can't be read. Use a copy without protection.
err_pdf_open: Could not open this PDF ({0}). The file may be corrupted.
err_pdf_password: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the protection before converting.
err_pdf_scanned: This PDF has no selectable text (it looks scanned, images only). Use a version with text or run the PDF through an OCR program first.
queued_lite: Queued (lite mode: one book at a time)
